airflow_version: 3.1.8 (executed with `airflow dags test`, single process, in the project workspace)
dag: retrain_recommender: spark_features -> train_retrieval -> build_knn -> evaluate_candidate -> quality_gate -> build_bundle -> promote

runs.name: smoke run 1 (tiny training budget)
runs.detail: build_knn failed: the neighbour matrix was saved before its output folder existed. A real bug found by the orchestrated run; fixed in scripts/itemknn_baseline.py.

runs.name: smoke run 2 (tiny training budget: 1 epoch of 100 steps)
runs.detail: quality_gate returned BLOCK: candidate Recall@100 0.1456 vs production 0.2323 (floor 0.2277). Downstream tasks (build_bundle, promote) were skipped by Airflow.

runs.name: full run (8 x 400 steps, same settings as production)
runs.detail: quality_gate returned PROMOTE: candidate Recall@100 0.2363 vs production 0.2323 (floor 0.2277). build_bundle trained both rankers (dev NDCG@10 0.1843 DCN-v2, 0.1859 Wide & Deep) and promote atomically pointed bundles/current at the new bundle, which loads and serves requests.

note: The retrained retriever differs slightly from the production one (TensorFlow training is not bit-for-bit deterministic across runs); the test-window numbers in results/final_test.json belong to the original bundle, not the DAG-built one.
